posts.name: Trajector
posts.cooked:
Here I am, to defend my characterization of Voss knocking six shards off OblivAeon as relatively easy!

It took the combined might of Ra and the Ennead to do enough damage to create ONE OblivAeon shard. Ra! And Atum, who vaporized a city! AND all the rest of them! Apparently, Voss is at least six times as powerful as that.

It's not because Voss is in the base set that I am skeptical of his power. It's that I never lose against him! Dawn is much harder. Heck, The Ennead is harder. This power level out of Voss is just so...surprising. Compared to the strike that the Egyptian pantheon delivered to OblivAeon, it sure does seem easy for Voss to knock chips off the guy.

posts.name: FrivYeti
posts.cooked:
Hang on.

C&A said that Setback created the Miststorm universe, but that's not right! 

Setback got involved and meddled with Chrono-Ranger's badge, thereby reversing time and creating a new timeline in which Chrono-Ranger didn't die and part of Rook City survived. That timeline isn't the Miststorm timeline. The Miststorm timeline is the one in which CR stayed dead, and Rook City was fully broken. The timeline that Setback created was the much more hopeful RPG timeline.

Am I missing something there?

posts.name: MindWanderer
posts.cooked:
In a sense, he created both.  Yes, the one with the time rewind he initiated is the Sentinel Comics universe.  But because he caused a fork, OblivAeon was in only one of the two.  Without Setback, the canon universe would have been one in which Rook City was destroyed but OblivAeon was defeated.  Because the heroes succeeded in that timeline, super-powered individuals wouldn't be on the outs with the general population, and because Voss would have been there, the Mist Storm wouldn't have been possible.  So it would have been somewhat darker than the Comics Universe timeline, but much less dark than the Mist Storm one.

But yes, the simple answer is that his action led to what happened in the RPG timeline, and the one in which he didn't act was the Mist Storm timeline.
